name: Sport Qory (Tourism and Sports Industry Support Fund)
via: Corporate fund created in 2010 (founder Kazsportinvest JSC); sole operator for allocating extra-budgetary sport funds since 2020; activity overseen by the Ministry of Culture and Sport and funded mainly by Samruk-Kazyna.
note: Kazakh sports support fund that manages the country's professional clubs, including the XDS Astana cycling team (transferred to the fund's management in 2024).
